notes: Dockerfile.final is ready for Buildah validation. The image uses ubuntu:22.04 base, installs required system packages (git, curl, build-essential, pkg-config, ca-certificates), copies setup scripts to /opt/benchmark/, executes repo_setup.sh to materialize /workspace from Apache Arrow commit 9986b7b, installs Miniconda at /opt/conda, then executes setup_runtime.sh to create the conda environment 'arrow-cpp' with all C++ dependencies. Verifier assets (eval.sh, test.patch, tests/) are correctly excluded from the image and will be runtime-mounted. Final WORKDIR is /workspace.
